Hi Susan — it was great to meet you at BioAI last week. Thanks again for carving out time in the expo hall; I appreciated hearing more about Novus Health's plans to put LLMs into clinical summarization and patient triage. Quick recap from our conversation and proposed next steps so we can align internally on priorities:

What I heard
- Primary goal: deploy a privacy-safe summarization assistant that can run on protected data with deterministic latency under 300ms for short summaries (<=256 tokens).
- Key constraints: strict PHI handling, SOC2+/HIPAA posture, and predictable unit costs for high daily throughput.
- Current evaluation plan: shortlist runtimes and collect latency/cost for 10K sample requests.

Redwood fit / initial ask
- We can spin up a short pilot on a private deployment (VPC) to demonstrate latency and cost with your sample payloads.
- Proposal: 2–3 day technical sync to align on sample set and endpoints, followed by a 2-week pilot with our dedicated eval pool.

Next steps (proposed)
1) Can we schedule a 30–45m technical sync the week of Feb 23 to go over sample schema and network setup? (I'll bring our infra engineer.)
2) If that looks good, I'll share a concise pilot plan and an access checklist for your security team.

Attaching a one-pager that outlines the pilot flow and what we measure in the evaluation.

Thanks — would love to lock a time that works for you.

Best,
